power.method: PoE (IEEE 802.3af Class 3) or 12-24VDC external power, with seamless PoE/Aux failover

storage.notes: Two microSD/microSDHC/microSDXC slots, Class V10 or better recommended; tested maximum total capacity 1.5TB

features: iCS/CS thread lens mount; supports DC-iris, P-iris, or remote iCS lens zoom/focus/iris control (lens sold separately)
H.264 and H.265 HDSM SmartCodec technology plus Motion JPEG
Lightcatcher Technology for improved low-light image detail
ONVIF Profile S, T, M, and G compliant
FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certified onboard TPM and Secure Boot; optional FIPS Level 1 camera license or CRYPTR microSD for FIPS Level 3
AdaptAI video analytics with Focus of Attention (requires ACC7)

WDR up to 83dB off / 130dB dual-exposure (30fps) / 150dB triple-exposure (<=20fps) with WDR on

3D Noise Reduction Filter, Electronic Image Stabilization, up to 64 privacy zones, Tamper Detection
